parsed.explanation: In June 2024, NVIDIA executed a ten-for-one stock split and retroactively adjusted all historical share counts. This caused the fiscal year 2023 diluted shares to increase by exactly 10x, from 2,507,000,000 to 25,070,000,000.
parsed.evidence_quote: In June 2024, we executed a ten-for-one stock split of our common stock. All share, equity award, and per share amounts and related shareholders' equity balances presented herein have been retroactively adjusted to reflect the Stock Split.
